signal: Selerix acquired The Benefits eXpert (TBX) to build an all-in-one benefits administration SaaS platform

email.body1:
Mike, saw Selerix acquired TBX to pull benefits administration into one all-in-one platform.

An acquisition like that opens more broker and employer accounts than a region can cover before territories settle, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Selerix off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Selerix.

With a broader platform to sell, expectations on pipeline jump faster than regional headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Selerix needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Selerix.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Selerix's reply rate likely compares to other benefits-tech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional benefits-tech motion? I'll tailor it to Selerix either way.
